name: Emergency Exit Corridor
narrativeOnEnter: The final corridor. Laser grid active. You can see the emergency exit door at the far end. So close.

hotspots.label: Emergency Exit
lockedMessages: The electromagnetic lock is engaged. Set the lever combination first.
Levers set — but the laser grid is still active. Bypass it first.

hotspots.label: Laser Grid — Bypass
hotspots.lockedMessage: The laser grid control port needs a bypass chip. Find one in the utility systems.

action.text:
EMERGENCY EXIT PROTOCOL

1. Disengage EM locks via lever panel
2. Navigate laser grid to reach door
3. Use access card on door reader

WARNING: Once the exit sequence begins, you have 30 seconds before full facility lockdown.
